description: This file defines a React component named 'PainForm' which provides a user interface for logging pain entries, including fields for intensity, location, description, and occurred date/time. It manages state for form inputs and handles form submission by calling an API function.

methods.name: PainForm
methods.description: React component for pain entry form, handles user input and submission.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Event handler for form submission, creates pain entry via API and updates UI based on success or failure.
